units.source_text: “唔，”太吉郎点点头，“千重子，其实我让秀男看这条腰带画稿的时候，他就说不协调了。

en.t: "Mm," Taikichiro nodded. "Chieko, actually, when I showed Hideo the design sketch for this obi, he already said it did not harmonize.

units.source_text: 所以，我把那张画稿扔到秀男他们作坊旁边那条小河里去了。”

en.t: So I threw that sketch into the little river beside Hideo and the others' workshop."
